text:
exercise plan: beginner full body workout (30minutes)
warm up: 5 minutes walking in place, 5 minutes of arm twirling and leg swinging.
main movement:
1. push-ups - Kneel down 10 times three times.
2. sit down and stand up - 15three times each time, keep your back straight.
3. sit-ups - Slowly, 15 times, three times.
4. run in place - 1Repeat three times per minute.
finish: Walk lightly, catch your breath, and stretch your legs and shoulders..

exercise plan: chest exercises (40minutes)
warm up: Shoulder rotation and arm extension 5 minutes.
main movement:
1. push-ups (chest) - 12Four times each time.
2. Breast tightening - 15three times each time.
3. Lifting a heavy backpack sideways - 12three times each time.
4. Stretch out your chest on a stool - Three times, 30 seconds at a time.
finish: Slowly rotate your shoulders and gently stretch your chest muscles..

exercise plan: leg exercises (30minutes)
warm up: Bend and straighten your knees for 5 minutes.
main movement:
1. sit down and stand up - 20Four times each time.
2. take a step back (lunge) - 12 times per side three times.
3. calf raises - 20three times each time.
4. Sit on a chair and raise your legs - 15three times each time.
finish: Lightly walk in place to stretch your leg muscles.. If your knee hurts, stop immediately.

exercise plan: back exercises (30minutes)
warm up: 5 minutes of shoulder rotation and back stretching.
main movement:
1. Lie down quietly and raise your arms and legs (superman) - 10three times each time.
2. Lifting a heavy school bag and putting your back together - 12three times each time.
3. Pull your chin to your chest and straighten it. - 15three times each time.
4. Hold on to the wall and stretch your shoulders - 30three times a second.
finish: I arch my back and straighten my back to catch my breath..

exercise plan: abs exercises (20minutes)
main movement:
1. sit-ups - 15Four times each time.
2. leg lift - 12three times each time.
3. side twist - 15 times on each side three times.
4. bicycle riding action (lying down) - 30three times a second.
finish: Pull your knees to your chest and relax your lower back..

exercise plan: Weekly plan to walk 30 minutes every day
monday: 30 minutes brisk walking on level ground.
tuesday: Rest or light stretching.
Wednesday: 30 minutes walk including hills.
Thursday: Walk for 30 minutes on flat ground and do 30 sit-ups.
friday: rest.
saturday: 40minute long walk.
sunday: light stretching and walking.
Precautions: If your knees hurt, reduce your distance and choose your shoes carefully..

exercise plan: shoulder exercises (25minutes)
warm up: Slowly rotate your shoulders back and forth - 20 times in each direction.
main movement:
1. lift sideways - 12three times each time.
2. lift forward - 12three times each time.
3. press with shoulder (carrying a school bag) - 10three times each time.
4. shrug - 15three times each time.
finish: Finish by gently rotating both shoulders..

exercise plan: recovery exercise (15minutes)
Move slowly and breathe deeply.
1. Slowly turn your neck left and right - 5 times in each direction.
2. Rotate your shoulders back and forth - 10 times in each direction.
3. Slowly bend at the waist and place your hands on your toes. - 30seconds.
4. Pull one leg at a time to your chest. - 30 seconds each side.
5. Lie down and gently drop your knees from side to side. - 1minutes.
This exercise is good to do after exercise or before going to sleep..

Basic principles of exercise
first, It is important to keep doing it every day.. Do it every day, even for a short period of time.
second, Adjust the intensity to suit your body condition. Stop immediately if you feel sick..
third, Be sure to warm up before exercising, Do cool-down stretches after your workout.
fourth, Drink plenty of water and don't skip meals.
fifth, Get enough sleep to help your muscles recover.

The relationship between exercise and eating
Nutrition becomes more important when you exercise. White rice and barley rice, Eat mixed grain rice, beans and tofu., Get your protein boost with fish and chicken. Eat plenty of vegetables and fruits at every meal. If you eat lightly 30 minutes before exercise and within 30 minutes after exercise, you will recover quickly.. Drink water often and in small amounts during exercise..
